config.chain_rounds: lambda / (1 - lambda), lambda the chain's second largest modulus
config.check_map: each horizon T opens at ROUNDS - T and its map takes the payers' short shares from that round on
config.class_chain: classes and the spending state; each class's nodes weighted by stationary mass, by node count where the class has none
config.edge_lever: multiplies the weight of edges from the source class to the destination class, routes renormalized per source node
config.entry_term: K_c = (D v_c)_c - median over the other two home classes o of (D v_o)_c; v_t one claim spread evenly over t's trading nodes; D = (B - P) Z, P = pi ell', ell one on trading nodes and zero on the spending state
config.mean_field: A44's: propensity at the midpoint of each band; each payer short in the share of rounds from open_from with the control's holding below its share of the bill; the control's closing membership; issuance response zero. Rebuilt here from its parts (A45-0)
config.node_reading: (1 - p_c) / p_c, p_c the class's propensity
config.out_rate: a_c = sum over c's nodes of stationary mass times spend rate times the share of routes leaving c, over c's mass
config.pass_on: multiplies the short shares of payers still trading

criteria.detail: Holds on all 65 carriers, 15 defaults and 50 of A44's variants: the matrix assembled in this file from the mean field's routes, spending bands, payroll sets, short-payer shares and bill slope is bitwise equal to the matrix A44 builds.
criteria.name: A45-0  the rebuilt map is A44's mean field: assembled here from A44's parts, it equals A44's matrix bitwise on every carrier

criteria.detail: Holds on all 165 pairs of 15 carriers and 11 levers: the stationary vector's derivative from the fundamental matrix with its projector, Z (dB/dtheta) pi with dB a central difference at step 1e-06, differs from the central difference of the re-solved stationary vector by at most 1e-06 in every entry.
criteria.name: A45-1  the derivative of the stationary split is Z dB pi: it matches re-solving the split on either side of every lever

criteria.detail: Holds on all 235 maps, 15 carriers and 220 sweep points: every column of the class chain conserves claims to within 1e-12, and the chain carries the class sums of the stationary vector to themselves to within 1e-12, and the sums over the classes that hold claims add to one to within 1e-12.
criteria.name: A45-2  the class chain keeps the stationary split: weighted by stationary mass, it conserves claims and returns the class sums, which add to one

criteria.detail: Holds on all 165 pairs of 15 carriers and 11 levers: moving an edge lever changes only the routes out of its source class and raises the share they send into its destination class; a propensity lever changes only its class's spending rates; the elasticity lever raises the bill slope; the pass-on lever scales only the short shares of payers still trading.
criteria.name: A45-3  every lever moves what it names: the part of the map it is named for changes, in the named direction, and no other part does
